decisions.reason: The inertial sensor module was promoted to its own page in 2024, which signals results at or above aspiration, and it fits closely within the modular platform of a growing firm with slack.

The industrial AC input module was shown on its own page and highlighted as a launch in both years, which indicates satisfactory performance in a core industrial niche, so there is no trigger for search.
The relay module is only mentioned, but it is a low-cost building block close to the established offer, and an expanding firm with in-house production has the slack to carry it.
The LED control module is recent and its results are still uncertain, but carrying it costs little within the modular system and the firm's slack lets it wait for evidence.

The wallbox remote access service supports the strategic expansion into charging and energy management, so it is likely to be retained even while its results are still being judged against aspiration.
